v1.feedback: The leaf-as-unit lineage is genuinely preserved and recontextualized into a bird form — good chain fidelity. However, the bird silhouette is built from Math.random() offsets per leaf, so it will read as a noisy scatter cloud rather than a clean raptor shape at 320 instances; replace randomness with deterministic parametric wing curves (Bézier spines) so the silhouette snaps into recognition within 2 seconds. The background aureole + god-rays + starfield stack competes with the subject for attention — drop the rays and dim the aureole by 60% so the luminous bird IS the light source rather than sitting in front of a separate one. The expansion-over-time mechanic means the piece starts underwhelming; consider initializing at 70% expansion so the default frame already fills >30% of canvas width.
